name: Elementary Programming 7 — Practice Lab (EP_07)
description: Seventh Python practice of a Programming Basics course (lesson EP_07): storing related fields in a tuple, telling a quantity apart from a product kind, comparing baskets with set operations, building a new list while keeping the original, and using functions deliberately, then an independent order check and a 10+10 question theory and code-knowledge final test — an explanatory tutor, editable starter programs, checking cases, student-written code and runs, with a detailed HTML course.
